name: Aces, Straights and Flushes Poker
description: A seven-card stud variant where each player gets six personal cards and everyone shares a central joker as the seventh card. The joker is a bug: it can act as an ace or complete a straight or flush, but not build non-ace sets.
deck: Standard 52-card deck plus one shared joker

overview.description: A seven-card stud variant where each player gets six personal cards and everyone shares a central joker as the seventh card. The joker is a bug: it can act as an ace or complete a straight or flush, but not build non-ace sets.
overview.deck: Standard 52-card deck plus one shared joker

history.origins: Documented in dealer's choice circles as a stud variant with a shared bug joker.
timeline: Mid-late 20th century: Spread through home poker stud rotations.
Modern: Preserved as a niche mixed-game variant.
history.cultural: Represents creative home-game design where a single shared mechanic changes classic stud texture.
history.evolution: Keeps stud betting flow but adds a universal community bug card that reshapes equity across all players.

setup.players: From two to eight players may take part, as in standard seven-card stud; the game plays best with five to seven. Each player receives six personal cards and shares one center joker as the seventh card.
setup.deck: Standard 52-card deck and one joker placed face-up in center.
setup.dealing: Deal starts as stud: two down and one up to each player, with later streets as defined by house flow.

rules.objective: Make the best high poker hand using six personal cards plus the shared bug joker.
rules.gameplay: Post ante, place shared joker in center, deal and bet through stud streets, then showdown. The bug joker can represent an ace or complete straight/flush draws, but cannot create non-ace sets.
keyRules: Shared center joker is available to every active player at showdown.
Joker acts as a bug, not fully wild.
Bug may stand for an ace or straight/flush completion card.
Bug may not complete non-ace pairs/trips/quads.

strategy.basic: Track visible upcards and evaluate how often shared bug helps your line versus the table.
strategy.intermediate: Value ace-based structures more because bug can promote ace combinations.
strategy.advanced: Model shared-bug board effects; if many players show straight/flush shells, tighten marginal calls.
tips: Do not overvalue non-ace pair draws that bug cannot improve.
Shared-joker rounds increase tie frequency on straight/flush classes.

variations.name: ASAF Lowball
variations.description: Low-hand winner variant using table-agreed low ranking.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Lowball changes only hand evaluation and payouts; core stud engine and phases stay the same.

scoring.description: Pot game. Best high hand under bug-joker rule wins.
scoring.winCondition: Highest valid five-card poker hand at showdown wins.

synthesis.shortDescription: Stud poker with a shared center joker that behaves as a bug for every player.
